examples.text: Folget mir in stillschweigender Trauer, und weinet mit mir über dieser unzeitigen Baare.
examples.translation: March sadly after. Grace my mournings here / In weeping after this untimely bier.

examples.text: 1912, Martin Luther, Lutherbibel von 1912, Ecclesiastes 6:3 (with KJV translation)
examples.translation: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
examples.english: If a man beget an hundred children, and live many years, so that the days of his years be many, and his soul be not filled with good, and also that he have no burial; I say, that an untimely birth is better than he.
